info.description:
Managed Agents service. All /v1 endpoints require a Bearer Wave API Key;
issue it with `wave bootstrap`. Enter the raw Wave API Key in the SDK and Swagger UI bearer configuration.
Offset pagination returns data and an optional next_offset (omitted on the last page); message history uses next_after, and event lists resume from the last sequence.
JSON errors return {"type":"error","error":{"type":"api_error","message":"..."},"request_id":"req_..."}. File-transfer Range errors return text/plain; conditional downloads and health checks may return empty responses.
JSON requests reject unknown fields; non-multipart request bodies are limited to 2 MiB. Nullable fields use nullable; omission is not equivalent to null.
Interactive documentation: /swagger/index.html. OpenAPI 3 spec: /swagger/openapi.json; legacy Swagger 2: /swagger/doc.json.

[English](/swagger/index.html?lang=en) · [中文](/swagger/index.html?lang=zh-CN)

get.description:
Stream session events over SSE. Resume from the after query parameter or Last-Event-ID header; a cursor beyond event history is rejected. A ping comment is sent every 15 seconds. A nonempty after takes precedence over Last-Event-ID; when neither is provided, resume from 0. data contains the full Event JSON, id is sequence, and event is type. Errors before streaming return JSON; errors during streaming close the connection. Save the last received sequence before reconnecting.

Example (each message ends with a blank line):
```text
id: 1
event: task.created
data: {"session_id":"session_example","sequence":1,"task_id":"task_example","type":"task.created","data":{"task_id":"task_example"},"created_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:00Z"}

: ping
```

post.description:
Approval example: `{"approve":true}`; rejection example: `{"approve":false}`.
Success example: `{"result":"tool response","is_error":false}`; failure example: `{"result":"confirmed failure","is_error":true,"error_code":"remote_failure"}`.
Choose one example above. Swagger 2.0 cannot express mutually exclusive fields; do not send all fields from its automatically generated example together.
Submit exactly one of three forms: approval {"approve": true|false}; confirmed result {"result": "...", "is_error": false}; confirmed failure {"result": "...", "is_error": true, "error_code": "..."}. Do not combine approval and result; error_code requires is_error=true, and an empty string is a valid result. Identical approvals or complete results may be resubmitted, including after task completion; changing an existing decision returns 409. Waiting tasks are requeued.
